capabilities: Move the editor cursor and scroll views with Vim-style keys
Show keyboard hints over links, buttons, tabs, and sidebar items
Search and open notes without leaving the keyboard
Navigate note history and workspace tabs
Find text in the active note with /, n, and N
disambiguation: Not an editor-only Vim emulation; it adds modal control over the whole interface, including tabs, sidebars, and link hints.
extras: States it is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Vimium or Obsidian projects; collects no telemetry and makes no network requests. Requires Obsidian 1.5.0 or newer.
problem: Obsidian's interface is mostly mouse-driven for navigating links, tabs, and sidebars, and its built-in Vim mode covers only the editor, not the rest of the app.

relations.evidence: inspired by the keyboard model of the Vimium browser extension

summary: Modal keyboard-navigation plugin that brings Vimium-style Normal/Insert modes, link hints, and Vim keys to Obsidian's editor, tabs, and sidebars.
